tiers.description: Three stats, two dice, simple combat.
tiers.label: Basic
tiers.rules_text:
Roll one die and add 6 for your SKILL, two dice and add 12 for your STAMINA, and one die plus 6 for your LUCK. You start with 10 Gold.

**Fighting.** Each round, roll two dice and add your SKILL; then roll two dice and add your opponent's SKILL. Whoever scores higher wounds the other for 2 STAMINA. A tie means you both miss. Anyone reduced to 0 STAMINA is defeated.

**Testing your Luck.** Roll two dice. If the total is equal to or less than your LUCK you are lucky. Either way, subtract 1 from your LUCK.

tiers.description: Adds armour, equipment slots, experience and levels.
tiers.label: Medium
tiers.rules_text:
**Armour.** Every wound is reduced by the target's ARMOUR, but always does at least 1 damage. You may wear one weapon, one suit of body armour and one shield; their bonuses count only while equipped.

**Experience.** You begin at LEVEL 1 with 0 XP. Each enemy you defeat in a fight you win earns 10 XP, plus 5 for every level it is above yours (or minus 5 for every level below; always at least 1). When your XP reaches 100 times your LEVEL, subtract that much XP and go up a level: add 2 to your STAMINA and its starting value, and at every third level add 1 to your SKILL and its starting value. The highest level is 10.

tiers.description: Adds classes, skills and critical hits.
tiers.label: Advanced
tiers.rules_text:
**Your calling.** Choose a class: it grants your starting skills, which open choices other adventurers cannot take, and a bonus to your stats: a Ranger adds 1 to SKILL, a Rogue adds 2 to LUCK and a Scholar adds 1 to LUCK and 2 to STAMINA.

**Critical hits.** When an attack roll shows double six (a natural 12), its damage is doubled.
